officialSourceAssessment.nationalCustodian: Algeria's Ministry of Finance / Direction Générale du Domaine National is evidenced in official ministry publications as responsible for cadastral and land-conservation administration; this is national custodian evidence, not proof of an open Larbaa parcel service.
officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: No directly accessible first-party Larbaa or Blida-wilaya local cadastral map/API was evidenced. The official organizational material describes wilaya-level cadastre and land-conservation directorates but does not expose a public parcel endpoint.
